text:
Evelyn Park: Quick thread  I'm drafting a short deprecation timeline for `models/v1/predict` -> `models/v2/invoke`. Put the draft at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5100/files. PTAL.
Marco Silva: looks solid. Two suggestions: 1) add a short upgrade matrix mapping common SDK calls to new params, 2) highlight the model aliasing strategy for model swaps.
Evelyn Park: added a simple table and a sentence about aliasing best practices. Also added an example of a model-swap with fallback: `alias: llm-prod -> v2.1 ; fallback: v1.9`.
Aisha Khan: add a note for customers using Dedicated  they may need to coordinate with account teams to ensure capacity when pinning older model variants.
Evelyn Park: added that note and pinged sales/solutions.
DocsBot: lint OK but snippet-check found a python streaming example missing the `async for token in stream` line. Evelyn, can you patch?
Evelyn Park: fixed and pushed. CI Bot: docs-smoke/5100: passed.
Marco Silva: approved, landing in next docs deploy.
Aisha Khan: approved.
Evelyn Park: thanks! I'll add to the migration FAQ next.
